proves.claim: a board call by a claiming seat with a snapshot due returns within 20 ms of the same call with none due, on a dirty item folder

cli.io-item-wip.snapshot-does-not-block-.why: Without it every claiming seat's board call pays the snapshot's git cost, about 234 ms, once a minute per item.

proves.claim: after a board command returns, a detached worker, not the command's own process, writes refs/pullboard/wip/<item> holding the folder's uncommitted change

cli.io-item-wip.snapshot-survives-comman.why: Without it moving the snapshot off the command path would lose it when the CLI exits right after main returns.
